shared_elements: low-relief carved motifs on a stone surface
curving outlined forms with plain interiors
rounded circular or loop-like elements (eyes/discs in A's top figures, rings in B)
justification: Both surfaces carry schematic low-relief designs reduced to outlined shapes, and each includes rounded loop/disc-like forms, but that is about as generic as a correspondence can be. A shows a legible, registered composition of profile quadrupeds, a bird, plant-like fronds and a banded zigzag frieze stacked in horizontal tiers, whereas B shows only large curvilinear rings and spirals with no recognisable animal, figure, register or pattern band.
